The first friend pressed the doorbell 20 times.  
The second friend pressed it 1/4 times more than the first friend: 20 + (1/4 × 20) = 20 + 5 = 25 times.  
The fourth friend pressed it 60 times.  
The third friend pressed it 10 times more than the fourth friend: 60 + (10 × 60) = 60 + 600 = 660 times.  
Total doorbell rings = 20 + 25 + 660 + 60 = 765.

Answer: 765
